cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completing the party report. Give me arrivals, room changes and departures, in that order; I'll set the headings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want to know who was near your cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may put refreshments in a separate section. Start with arrivals; nobody gets skipped because they didn't eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember the kitchen guests. The arrivals are on my photos, but those aren't sorted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the photos; I'll sort them. You dictate the whole route once we're ready. We'll reach the kitchen under room changes, with everyone else, and you can check my spelling as I write.

reason: Replace repeated kitchen spotlight with controlled whole-report dictation, taking B photo-sorting obstacle seriously rather than seizing the available kitchen answer. Preserve the party context while avoiding inherited concealment failure.
